verdict.rationale: Martin documents proactive, AI-generated outputs built from connected user data: daily or weekly briefings, proactively drafted emails, automatic email labeling with follow-up actions, and wake-up calls covering your schedule. These are one-line doc claims, though, and none confirms that briefings analyze the user's own data rather than general information. They also arrive by email or phone rather than as an in-app insights surface. missing for 10: documented detail on what briefings or insights analyze, explicit suggestion or recommendation features beyond drafts, an in-app insights view, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
